summary: This is a Form 8-K/A amendment filed by Barclays Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC, as registrant for BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-5C41, a commercial mortgage-backed securities issuing entity. The amendment makes clerical revisions to co-lender agreements previously filed as exhibits 4.6 and 4.8 related to underlying mortgage loans. The filing does not report any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return. It is a routine administrative correction to prior filings.
